purpose: Defines one concise machine-readable Collection Job result summary without replacing source-specific candidates, collection reports, Coverage Observation, retry artifacts, review, promotion, or publication state.
closure_rules: campaign_id and job_id must exactly match the Collection Job
system_id must exactly match the Collection Job and Coverage Observation
runner_used must be permitted by Collection Job runner_policy and Acquisition Registry routing
requested_scope must equal the Collection Job scope normalized to Coverage Observation scope shape
observed_scope coverage_claim records_discovered records_updated unresolved_dates unresolved_meeting_ids and source_errors must exactly mirror Coverage Observation
rank_counts must contain exactly C B B+ A A+ non-negative integer fields
the sum of rank_counts must not exceed records_discovered
artifact_refs must be a non-empty unique array of repository data paths
artifact_refs must include the Coverage Observation artifact used to build the manifest
generated_at must be a valid date-time not earlier than the Coverage Observation checked_at
the manifest is a summary and must not contain review approval promotion publication or deployment state
explicit_exclusions: no source bodies or raw HTML
no participant horse jockey trainer betting odds result payout prediction or tip data
no credentials cookies tokens restricted-access details or bypass instructions
no review approval promotion publication or deployment fields
no silent replacement of source-specific candidate report coverage or retry artifacts
